source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Dotenv uses a StoreBuilder to read the .env file, which Parser and Lexer split into entries. The Loader writes them into an adapter repository ($_SERVER, $_ENV, putenv) and Validator checks the required variables.
